title: Scaffold the opum-quest Claude Code plugin, gated by claude plugin eval (OPAG-38 federation half)
description:
Directed by opum-agent (OPAG-41 cross-session ruling, 2026-09-05, PLAN.md section 8): per-repo Claude Code skill distribution is retired for both quest-cli and lore-cli. Today `quest agents --update-instructions --target claude` (and `quest init --agent-instructions`) unconditionally writes a per-repo project skill at .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md (src/application/agents/agent-instructions.ts:124-170, called from src/cli/main.ts:773,907-908). The replacement: the skill ships once from a Claude Code plugin marketplace entry; init/agents only prime the CLAUDE.md nudge block. This is OPAG-38's still-open federation half.

lore-cli already shipped the mirror of this exact task as LCLI-441 (Done). Mirror it precisely rather than reinventing the shape:

- lore-cli's .claude-plugin/plugin.json (read in full):
  {
    "name": "opum-lore",
    "version": "0.4.2",
    "description": "Drive the lore CLI: ... Cut from the same lore-cli repository and tag as the CLI itself, so this skill can never describe a version you don't have.",
    "author": { "name": "Opum", "url": "https://github.com/opum-ai" },
    "homepage": "https://github.com/opum-ai/lore-cli",
    "repository": "https://github.com/opum-ai/lore-cli",
    "license": "MIT",
    "keywords": ["lore", "documentation", "okf", "docs", "cli"]
  }
  plugin.json's version is bumped in lockstep with package.json's version at release time (LCLI-441 implementationNotes). Mirror this shape for quest-cli: name "opum-quest" (already the name OPAG-41 uses for it), version matching quest-cli's own package.json (currently 0.3.3) at scaffold time, homepage/repository pointing at opum-ai/quest-cli.

- lore-cli's skills/lore/SKILL.md (the plugin's copy, at repo root under skills/, NOT under .claude/skills/) is a separate, hand-adapted copy - NOT byte-identical to the per-repo generated SKILL.md or to buildSkillDoc()'s template. LCLI-441's implementation notes explain why: it deliberately drops sections referencing lore-cli's own internal-only tooling (a "Commit-side-effect preflight" section naming an internal script path) and replaces them with a generic pointer to the consuming repo's own instructions. Quest-cli's per-repo template (questSkillContent, agent-instructions.ts:102-118) is already fairly generic/pointer-only ("This skill is a pointer, not a manual... Drive tracker state through quest, never by editing .quest/ by hand") - review it for anything quest-cli-internal-only before deciding whether it can be reused as-is or needs the same kind of adaptation lore did.

- ROOT-CLUTTER WARNING, learned by lore-cli the hard way: the plugin ships as the WHOLE REPOSITORY AT ITS RELEASE TAG - anything at quest-cli's root ships in the plugin cache. Keep new scaffold files out of root clutter, or put them in a clearly-scoped subdirectory.

- Gate: `claude plugin eval` per opum-agent's docs/reference/plugin-eval-authoring.md (390 lines, the only record of this undocumented Claude Code feature), which now records ELEVEN defects across three suites to avoid repeating:
  1. Case prompt asked for an action an empty sandbox couldn't support (no scaffold used).
  2. A spec-literal format string used as the PRIMARY pass condition instead of a secondary (weight 0.5) check.
  3. max_turns too small (12) for a task that reads a repository - repo-reading work needs ~600-900s/25-40 turns.
  4. Judged by default haiku instead of a sonnet-tier+ judge.
  5. A fixture contained the exact judged sentence, so both ablation arms scored 1.000 and the case measured nothing.
  6. A not_contains regex grader fired on a correct response that quoted the disallowed phrase in order to reject it - negative regexes over natural language systematically penalize engagement; prefer positive graders or position-anchored negatives.
  7. "Tools follow graders" violated in reverse: a criterion implied a side effect the case's allowed_tools couldn't produce, failing a genuinely correct response.
  8. A conjunctive grader ANDed six conditions in one criterion - the judge only needed to doubt one of six to fail a strong response.
  9. An illustrative example list was read by the judge as an exhaustive requirement, failing a better response not on the list.
  10. A fixture directly contradicted its own grader's premise.
  11. A weight-0.5 grader implied a counterparty (e.g. AskUserQuestion / a human to ask) that does not exist in the eval sandbox, capping the case regardless of correctness.

  Floor invariants (doc lines 36-46): at least 1 should-NOT-fire case; every case has at least 1 outcome grader (not just tool_used); runs:3 minimum; --ablation with-without stays on. Preferred check hierarchy: verifiable > binary criterion > n-ary > llm rubric > preference. Judge must be sonnet-tier+, never the same model as the agent under test. Never pipe `claude plugin eval` output - a shell pipeline reports the last stage's exit status, silently masking a failing suite (hit live in OPAG-41's own implementation notes).

  Real invocation lore-cli used and quest-cli should mirror: `claude plugin eval . --ablation with-without --no-publish --judge-model sonnet --threshold 1` (default runs:3). Pilot first with `--runs 1` to confirm suite.plugins lists the plugin with no manifest_invalid/disabled_by_default/will_not_load problem.

Not in scope: publishing/registering the marketplace entry itself - opum-agent owns opum-marketplace/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json and pins it to a release tag once plugin.json is on dev (per the earlier ruling in this session's history); this task only gets plugin.json onto quest-cli's dev and reports the repo+ref to opum-agent.

acceptanceCriteria.text: .claude-plugin/plugin.json exists, named opum-quest, version matching quest-cli's own package.json version at scaffold time, mirroring lore-cli's .claude-plugin/plugin.json field shape (name/version/description/author/homepage/repository/license/keywords) with quest-cli's own values

A skill file exists (adapted from, not necessarily byte-identical to, the per-repo questSkillContent template) that is a pointer to the CLI, not a manual - reviewed for and stripped of anything referencing quest-cli-internal-only tooling, mirroring why lore's plugin skill differs from its per-repo one

An evals/ suite exists with at least one should-fire case and at least one should-NOT-fire case, each with a primary outcome grader (llm or verifiable, not a bare tool_used trigger check alone), a sonnet-tier+ judge, and runs>=3 - each of the eleven recorded defects in opum-agent's plugin-eval-authoring.md is explicitly checked against and avoided, with a one-line note per defect saying how this suite avoids it

claude plugin eval . --ablation with-without --no-publish --judge-model sonnet --threshold 1 exits 0, verified without piping the command's output (which masks a failing exit code), for both a --runs 1 pilot (confirming no manifest_invalid/disabled_by_default/will_not_load problem) and the full run
New root-level clutter is avoided or contained to a clearly-scoped subdirectory, since the plugin ships as the entire repository at its release tag

Marketplace registration is explicitly out of scope and stated as such - this task ends with plugin.json on dev and a report of the repo+ref to opum-agent, who owns pinning the opum-marketplace entry to a release tag

implementationNotes: AC1: .claude-plugin/plugin.json created, name opum-quest, version 0.3.3 (matches package.json at scaffold time), fields mirror lore-cli's .claude-plugin/plugin.json shape exactly (name/version/description/author/homepage/repository/license/keywords) with quest-cli's own values.

AC2: skills/quest/SKILL.md created at repo root (plugin-owned copy, distinct from the per-repo .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md that questSkillContent still generates). Adapted rather than byte-copied: fixed the one stale/target-specific line ('the versioned protocol block Quest manages in AGENTS.md' -> '...in this project's agent-instructions file (CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, depending on how this repository configured quest agents --update-instructions)') since the plugin's copy can't assume which target a given consuming repo uses. No quest-cli-internal-only content existed in the source template to strip (unlike lore's skill, which had to drop a section naming its own internal backlog-handover tooling) - confirmed by review.

AC3: evals/quest-task-request (should-fire) and evals/quest-no-trigger (should-NOT-fire) created, mirroring lore-cli's evals/lore-doc-request and evals/lore-no-trigger structure exactly (prompt.md with max_turns:8/allowed_tools:[Read,Glob,Grep,Skill], an llm-type primary outcome grader, and a display-only tool_used skill-fired indicator marked with-only/unscored). Checked against each of the eleven recorded defects: (1) no scaffold needed - advice-only prompts, mirrors lore's own successful shape; (2) primary grader is qualitative outcome text, not a spec-literal string match, and command examples are hedged '(or equivalent)' to avoid being read as an exhaustive list (defect 9's fix applied proactively); (3) max_turns:8 matches lore's own successful budget for an advice-only case, no repo-reading required; (4) --judge-model sonnet passed explicitly at invocation, never left at default haiku; (5) no fixture/scaffold exists to leak the judged answer; (6) no negative/not_contains regex grader used at all; (7) the outcome grader implies only Skill-tool/prose steering, which allowed_tools grants - no ungranted side effect implied; (8) grader is one qualitative criterion, not a multi-condition AND; (10) no fixture exists to contradict a grader premise; (11) the grader explicitly allows (not requires) 'ask a clarifying question' as one of several acceptable responses, never implying an unavailable counterparty.

AC4: pilot (claude plugin eval . --runs 1 --ablation with-without --no-publish) confirmed clean plugin resolution (suite.plugins lists opum-quest 0.3.3 at the repo path, no manifest_invalid/disabled_by_default/will_not_load). Full gate (claude plugin eval . --ablation with-without --no-publish --judge-model sonnet --threshold 1, default runs:3, exit code read directly - not piped) exited 0: quest-no-trigger with 1.00/without 1.00/delta 0.00 (skill correctly did not fire in either arm, judge unanimous 3/3 x 6 runs); quest-task-request with 1.00/without 0.00/delta +1.00 (skill correctly fired only with the plugin, judge unanimous 3/3 PASS with-arm and unanimous 3/3 FAIL without-arm, x6 runs). aggregate-result.json: schemaVersion 1, claudeVersion 2.1.261, judgeModel sonnet, threshold 1, partial false, durationSeconds 339, costUsd 1.86.

AC5: all new files (.claude-plugin/plugin.json, skills/quest/SKILL.md, evals/) placed at the exact same locations lore-cli's already-accepted scaffold uses - no additional root clutter beyond that established, vetted pattern. Added **/evals/results/ to .gitignore (mirroring lore-cli's identical entry) so eval run artifacts are never committed; also removed a stale .codex/handovers/ gitignore line left over from QCLI-232's .codex/ deletion.

AC6: marketplace registration explicitly out of scope, not attempted here - opum-marketplace/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json belongs to opum-agent, who pins it to a release tag once this lands on dev, per the ruling already recorded in this session.
finalSummary: Scaffolded the opum-quest Claude Code plugin: .claude-plugin/plugin.json (name opum-quest, version 0.3.3), a plugin-owned skills/quest/SKILL.md (adapted from the per-repo questSkillContent template, target-agnostic instructions-file wording), and an evals/ suite with a should-fire (quest-task-request) and should-NOT-fire (quest-no-trigger) case, both mirroring lore-cli's already-shipped LCLI-441 pattern exactly. Verified against every one of opum-agent's eleven recorded plugin-eval defects before running anything, not after. Full gate (claude plugin eval . --ablation with-without --no-publish --judge-model sonnet --threshold 1, default runs:3) exited 0 with clean deltas: quest-no-trigger 0.00 (correctly silent), quest-task-request +1.00 (correctly fires, judge unanimous 18/18 votes across both cases). bun run check, lore check, and quest doctor all clean with the new top-level directories in place. Marketplace registration intentionally out of scope - reporting the ref to opum-agent once this merges to dev.
